notes: Adds surface_examples.v1.0.0.md as the normative specimen library for valid reader-facing output shapes.
Defines orthogonal output axes: artifact type, content length, and render target.
Adds condensed, standard, and expanded devotional length profiles without allowing length to determine source count.
Keeps spoken-language and TTS survival requirements active across all standard devotional length profiles.
Adds minimal and extensive source-lineage specimens to prevent accidental inference of a fixed Additional References count.
Adds an optional study-guide specimen as a separate companion artifact with images disabled.
Adds a labeled PDF devotional specimen with images, entities, and UI-only tokens forbidden.
Updates the canonical JSON bundle with output-profile enums, PDF entity prohibitions, and the surface-example registry.
Registers normative specimen identifiers in render directives and corresponding compatibility checks in lint.
Clarifies that examples illustrate valid realization but never override governing YAML or lint contracts.
Preserves the mandatory primary quotation contract for every devotional output.

Image fallback standing order: search similar accessible images, then generate unless the user objects, then a single italic cue only when neither can display an image. Aligns process, engine, render, lint, embedded UI template, examples, and golden fixtures; allows supported image renderers when image_group is unavailable. Refreshes manifest paths to the files present in this stack.
